title: The weekend
blurb: A run, a game, and a coffee date.

paragraphs.zh: 周末我有时间。星期六早上我去跑步。我跑了一个小时，很累，可是很高兴。
paragraphs.en: At the weekend I have time. On Saturday morning I go running. I ran for an hour; I'm tired but happy.

paragraphs.zh: 下午我在家玩电脑。我最喜欢的游戏很难，可是很有意思。
paragraphs.en: In the afternoon I play on my computer at home. My favourite game is hard, but really interesting.

paragraphs.zh: 晚上女朋友给我打电话。她说：“你明天有空吗？我们一起去喝咖啡吧！”
paragraphs.en: In the evening my girlfriend calls me. She says: "Are you free tomorrow? Let's go for a coffee!"

paragraphs.zh: 我说：“好啊！几点见面？”她说：“下午三点，我们在地铁站见面。”
paragraphs.en: I say: "Sure! What time shall we meet?" She says: "Three in the afternoon. Let's meet at the subway station."

paragraphs.zh: 我可能会迟到，可是我一定去！
paragraphs.en: I might be late, but I'll definitely be there!
